Description: The system shall evaluate candidate survey responses against trial protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria and classify eligibility status.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Ineligible candidate flagged with specific failed criteria; Fail: Subject with exclusion criteria marked eligible.

Description: The system shall allow a Trial Candidate to submit a pre-screening medical survey.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Form saves and shows success message. Fail: Form rejects submission and highlights missing required fields.

Description: The system shall allow Clinical Researchers to view a filtered list of eligible candidates.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Dashboard updates on page refresh to display only candidates who currently pass eligibility criteria.
Rationale (short): Researchers need to identify who to recruit.

Description: The system shall track informed consent milestones (specifically 'Consent Signed' and 'Consent Withdrawn') for each recruited candidate.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: System allows Clinical Researcher to update status to 'Consent Signed' or 'Consent Withdrawn' and automatically logs the timestamp.
Rationale (short): Legal and ethical requirement for trials.
Comments: Broadened AC to cover multiple milestones.

Description: The system shall allow Clinical Researchers to maintain a visit compliance log for enrolled subjects.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Researchers input visit dates; system automatically flags any visit delayed by >48 hours past the scheduled date.
Rationale (short): Ensures data integrity for the trial.

Description: The recruitment database must comply with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record standards including cryptographic audit trails.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Benchmarking tests confirm <500ms response time at 200 concurrent users and required security standards under load.
Comments: Replaced placeholder latency with concrete target.

Description: The system's user interface shall be responsive on both desktop and mobile web browsers.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: The survey renders without horizontal scrolling or overlapping elements on standard mobile screens (e.g., 375px width).
Rationale (short): Candidates will likely use personal devices.
Comments: Clarified phrasing to avoid WCAG confusion.
